notes: The report gives the compiler's two chains to the book of Mu'awiya b. Hakim; it carries no saying
«أبي» is the compiler's father, not named: a relation link
The second chain names «محمد بن الحسن» and then «محمد بن الحسن الصفار» with a fresh «عن» each; read as two men, not merged
Blessings («رضي الله عنهما») are left out
